clauses.clause: Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: target slot (cast): 1..1 of the six creatures (yours and the opponent's); e.g. [cast targets=['you_bear']]: you_bear 2/2 -> 3/2, +FIRST_STRIKE; after the turn ends: 3/2 -> 2/2, -FIRST_STRIKE; same on each target; you: mana R-1; card -> graveyard.
